protocol.source: Spring-Gaus (Zhong et al., ECCV 2024) released mpm_synthetic.zip (Google Drive id 1HKYOPG9gNDSmfLkhUo5W0Lw9sM8LGGbm); render/<scene>/{camera.json,frame.json,physical.json,camera_xxx/NNN.png}
protocol.note_engine: Spring-Gaus synthetic sequences are MPM simulations (README: "generated using Material Point Method"), elastic only, rendered in Blender; Spring-Gaus itself fits a spring-mass model. Their MPM solver/constitutive model/ground friction differ from ours, so rankings and calibrated error are the target, not raw equality.

excluded.torus_heterogeneous: heterogeneous E/nu field, no scalar GT

protocol.frames: 30 frames (dt 0.03 s, 0-0.87 s) -> 64 by nearest repetition; 512->224 px; RGBA composited on black; V-JEPA2 tubelet 2 -> 32 steps
protocol.models: V2 main 9 runs v2main_B_seed17, v2main_B_seed29, v2main_B_seed43, v2main_C_seed17, v2main_C_seed29, v2main_C_seed43, v2main_D_seed17, v2main_D_seed29, v2main_D_seed43 (best_material.pt, val-selected), no retraining
protocol.ensemble: mean z over 9 runs (per mode: K0/offset/ridge computed per run then averaged); law = majority vote of run argmax
protocol.adaptation: leave-one-scene-out over the scored scenes; support = other scenes x 3 triplets; offset = mean support residual; ridge_last_layer = closed-form ridge delta on the last Linear of param_head (lambda = 1.0 * mean ||h||^2, bias unpenalised); support_mean_baseline = mean support GT z, no video. Hyperparameters copied from v3c PAC-NeRF check, not tuned.
protocol.law: all scenes elastic -> GT law = jelly; law-head refit not possible (single class), only K0 law reported
protocol.metrics: Spearman / pairwise order of E/rho (z) vs GT over scored scenes (ties excluded from pairs); Spearman of nu; MAE in train-standardised z (V2 stats) for E/rho and nu
